objective: Sincronizar REAL CIENFUEGOS del 2026-09-01 al 2026-09-14 inclusive usando el handler oficial. Debe sincronizar encabezado Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 y detalle ISCAM, y luego validar el destino. No tocar Edarsahub_Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_destination_sep_after_sync
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dias, CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ventas_total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total, SUM(ISNULL(tickets_total,0)) AS tickets_total, SUM(ISNULL(pax_total,0)) AS pax_total FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1

queries.name: cienfuegos_source_sep
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_total, COUNT(*) AS tickets_total, SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_total FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos tr ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND tr.apertura<'2026-09-15 00:00:00' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
